features.fullDescription: Large harled mansion of various dates. Original part probably 1484 recast 16th century, 3-storey L-plan with circular re-entrant stair-tower now gutted. Buttresses at back added mid 18th century. W. wing originally plain 2-storey and basement 3-window. Circular tower heightened probably c. 1800, back wing with bow probably of same date. Large reconstruction John Smith 1840: old house doubled to form approximately symmetrical U-plan section with centre gable, interior almost completely remodelled. Porch and quoins added to early 18th century W. wing probably a little later. Extensively restored 1954-55
